name: SFP Tech Holdings Berhad
overview: 2026年SFP Tech的公告主要为股份拆细/附加上市、董事委员会成员变动及季度业绩，未见涉及业务板块扩张、新增业务、缩减或出售的公告。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收3910.5万MYR，同比增36.4%；净利润739.5万MYR，同比增1181.6%。
overview_en: In 2026, SFP Tech's announcements mainly comprised additional listing/subdivision of shares, changes in board committee members, and quarterly results. No announcements related to business segment expansion, new businesses, downsizing, or divestments were observed. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 39.105 million, up 36.4% year-on-year; net profit was MYR 7.395 million, up 1,181.6% year-on-year.
